title: US single release: Arrow Through Me by Wings | 1979
content:
Wings’ single ‘Arrow Through Me’ was released in the United States on 10 August 1979.

It was the band’s second US single from the Back To The Egg album, and the follow-up to ‘Getting Closer’. The b-side was ‘Old Siam, Sir’.

I have always had a soft spot for this song. There’s a nice horn riff in it, and it’s funky. Sometimes you write to get a sort of feeling rather than a perfectly ‘correct’ lyric. Sometimes the lyric can be secondary to the feeling. This one has as much, or more, to do with the feel of the song, the groove.
Paul McCartney
The Lyrics: 1956 To The Present

‘Arrow Through Me’ peaked at number 29 on the US Billboard Hot 100 on 13 October 1979.
